t: Zhang Shijie had about 1,000 ships chained together in the bay, with the emperor's boat in the centre, to stop individual ships from fleeing, but the chained ships could neither support the middle nor retreat.
The Yuan cut the Song off from fresh water and wood on land, and the Song soldiers were forced to eat dry foods and drink sea water, which caused nausea and vomiting.
Zhao Bing was the last Song emperor, and his death effectively ended the Song dynasty and left the Yuan under Kublai Khan with all of the country.
dyk: Zhang Shijie had the palaces, houses and forts on land burned so that his soldiers could not flee the battle, and Yuan sailors lulled the Song with festive music before the attack.
ev: The Southern Song court flees Lin'an, leaving Emperor Gong to be captured, and Zhao Shi is declared emperor
Fuzhou falls to the Yuan, and the court flees towards Quanzhou, where Pu Shougeng refuses it boats
Zhao Shi dies and is succeeded by Zhao Bing, aged seven, whom Zhang Shijie brings to Yamen; Wen Tianxiang is captured
Zhang Hongfan, reinforced by Li Heng, attacks the Song navy at Yamen, and Zhang Shijie has about 1,000 ships chained together
The Yuan blockade the bay and the Song run out of supplies, and Zhang Hongfan prepares an assault on 18 March
The Yuan overwhelm the Song fleet, and Lu Xiufu jumps into the sea with the boy emperor, and both drown
Dowager Yang takes her own life at sea, and Zhang Shijie is assumed to have drowned in a tropical storm

f.date: 19 March 1279, after a blockade and an assault prepared on 18 March
f.place: The bay at Yamen (also called Yashan), now in the town of Yamen, Xinhui County, Jiangmen, Guangdong, southern China
f.sides: The Southern Song under Zhang Shijie and the prime minister Lu Xiufu, with about 1,000 ships chained together and many non-combatants; the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty under Zhang Hongfan, reinforced by Li Heng
f.outcome: The Song fleet was overwhelmed and the boy emperor Zhao Bing died in the sea, which effectively ended the Song dynasty and left the Yuan under Kublai Khan with all of China
